claim: Why do people save items on Facebook Marketplace? - Reddit
summary: I sell a few handmade items on Facebook Marketplace and I get a lot of views, shares and saves. What’s the point of saving an item on there? The items are first come, first serve, so if you saved the item for a later date, it will be gone.
